failures.counterexample_clause: FR-6: Apply every distinct applicable discourage predicate during ranking. Multiple different policy predicates accumulate; ranking uses base score minus the complete soft-penalty total.

profile.label: Novice, low-activity owner wants a quiet low-key cat

relevant_rule_rows.reason: Low noise tolerance: very vocal breeds are discouraged.
Low owner activity: high-energy breeds are discouraged.
Novice owner: demanding high-energy breeds are discouraged.

failures.reviewer_policy: Distinct applicable soft rules compose. Each distinct discourage predicate contributes one point; evaluating only the first matching soft rule is incorrect.

failures.counterexample_clause: FR-7: Merge structured discourage rows and narrative soft tags by semantic predicate. Identical cat_attribute/cat_op/cat_value predicates incur one penalty total, even when both surfaces express them.

profile.label: Structured and narrative inputs express the same energy concern
profile.narrative_note: I want a calm, low-key cat rather than a high-energy companion.

relevant_oracle_tag_rules.reason: Narrative note: owner wants a low-key cat; high-energy breeds discouraged.

relevant_rule_rows.reason: Low owner activity: high-energy breeds are discouraged.

failures.reviewer_policy: Structured policy and a narrative tag can express the same soft concern. Deduplicate soft adjustments by the semantic predicate (cat_attribute, cat_op, cat_value) so the same concern is applied once across surfaces.

failures.counterexample_clause: FR-12: If an applicable rule kind, trait operator, cat operator, attribute, or ordinal value is unsupported, ESCALATE and cite that rule ID. Never silently skip uninterpretable policy.
